fact: Two Botswana developers, Kitso Speaks and Glen Mokoka, built an AI system that understands and communicates in standard Setswana, trained on a dataset they collected, per Global South World relaying the Guardian Sun.

Guardian Sun reports that two Batswana, Kitso Speaks and Glen Mokoka, built a Setswana AI trained on a self-collected dataset of books, newspapers and recorded conversations, self-funded, with mobile apps and dialects still in development.

Orion X, whose team first took root in Botswana, offers its Uhuru African language model to users via WhatsApp, SMS, USSD and a web app, with a free tier and a USD 7 (P99) monthly Pro tier, per CEO Mthabisi Bokete and Chief AI Officer Kgengwenyane.

Tlou Energy says it signed a binding Heads of Agreement with Kala Data FZCO to develop a containerised high-density computational facility, for hosting servers or GPUs and AI and machine learning work, at its Lesedi project, with work to begin immediately.
